_comment: Phase 1 matrix vs REAL repo. Recon (T0/T2) confirmed real prefixes are /api/techscape/v1/* and /api/travel/v1/* (NOT /api/techscape/* — the router mount adds /v1). 'admin' column below is the spec's branch-admin tier, which core/deps.py stores as role='manager' (bare 'admin' is reserved for the legacy top rank == super_admin — see core/deps.py docstring). Token minting REQUIRES --biz <active business id> AND --sub <real ts_users id whose actual DB role matches the column> — core/deps.get_current_user re-reads the DB row and ignores the token's role claim, so access_matrix.py's mint() must be given real per-role user ids (it currently mints with no --sub/--biz at all and will fail against this repo's RBAC model). Wiki uses 201/204 on create/delete; users/branches use 201 on create.
_notes: travel_leads endpoint removed from this P1 matrix — leads/assigned-only scoping is P2 scope per gogaga-backend Phase gates, not built in this phase.

PATCH/DELETE target-id tests, out-of-branch 404s, role-elevation 403s, and the token-invalidation chain were verified in T3-T5 task chains with real per-role DB fixtures (not this static spec) — see PHASE1_REPORT.md.
